scope: One pure native-reader action or the explicitly bounded offline adoption described below. No solver/build/Git/GenCase, original safety unchanged.

parameters.ExecutionAuthorized: Required switch. The unique selected configuration/window must already exist among the six prepared jobs; DebugCPU is smoke only.

paths.overwrite_policy: All four reader output/log/record paths must be absent. Failed analysis preserves its call and partial output; it never reruns the completed solver.

preflight_authority: Exact prepared six-job manifest and actual run stage/CPU/configuration/window/tag are required, with passed and unchanged closure flags
Actual solver call must have owned, direct, immediately captured integer exit0, matching project program/target and all prepared arguments; fixture/Run overrides are rejected

Actual run source_build must match the exact current HG-column authoritative CPU86 project-main build; source inputs, objects, archived/current source pairs, runtime, tool records, canonical programs and every actual raw output hash remain bound before and after reading
Every expected PART is present in the exact completed raw file inventory and bound by its actual Run; no extra/missing PART/piece is admitted

Reader helper must prove actual85 CPU non-main objects plus one helper, exact86 link closure, four runtimes and passed owned compile/link calls. Retained helpers use objects/link_object_count; new short helper uses project_objects/object_count/frozen_inputs_unchanged/actual_project_classes_no_stubs. Actual owned linker arguments are independently checked for the same85+1 objects without main in either schema, and actual compile arguments must select the one declared reader CPP.

Historical reader builds are provenance. Historical original source/doc entries are mapped by exact path/hash/size to their archived copies; old source originals are never asserted equal to today's solver. New short reader additionally binds the actual HG ReleaseCPU build. Optional old project_call log fields are handled without fabricating a log.

clock_truth.method: Independently regenerate integer saved completed steps; exact native CSV clock bits must equal completed_steps*locked_binary_dt. The sealed typed C++ reader also checks native BI4 time, zero-based saved Step and typed locked dt exactly.
clock_truth.event_completed_steps: 5243 coarse / 10486 half; drainage is active only strictly after the event step
clock_truth.saved_schedule: Coarse union: 0..65536 stride64; 5120..5376 stride1; 66560..262144 stride1024. Half doubles each completed step. Short keeps the first458 through coarse13120/half26240; smoke is0,1,2.
clock_truth.manifest_time_s: Deserialized JSON time differences are recorded as diagnostics only, never equality gates. Original JSON/native clock data are not modified.

original_thresholds_and_guards.typed_schema: Original15 typed arrays + six double dynamic arrays + true float PosDiv =22; typed bool/uint/uint/double public metadata;1000 soil+40 fixed IDs, no exclusions, finite fields and exact original native identity/topology
original_thresholds_and_guards.ledger: All1000*samples soil V/rho/n/k/J ledgers and40*samples fixed public-zero markers are checked by the typed reader, relative ledger error<=5e-13; fixed J/theta/original15 are never zeroed or masked
original_thresholds_and_guards.signed_necessary_step: Every noninitial interval is nonempty and signed dterror<=1e-14; retain signed semantics and initial-sentinel exclusion, never replace it with abs(dterror) or zero
original_thresholds_and_guards.drainage: Independently recheck every history activeDrainCount=0 before/at event and10 after event; retain actual native FSType/pressure receiver checks inside the typed reader. Density/J are not frozen on drained receivers.
original_thresholds_and_guards.exports: Exactly13 unchanged leaf names; validate all five binary headers and exact byte lengths, all1040 initial IDs, final soil1000 J/n/theta CSV IDs40..1039, every history clock/mask/ledger error and all26 named physical columns. All1040 J/theta states remain covered by common_j_theta.bin and all fixed states by fixed_samples.csv. Column21 is actual ExcessPorePress, actual PosDiv remains separate.
original_thresholds_and_guards.CSV_scope: The wrapper reparses ID/history/final-state/column CSV summaries. It records zero ledger_CSV_rows_reparsed; exhaustive ledger values are verified directly from typed BI4 by the owned real reader.

limitations: Prepared only; this note does not assert any reader run or passed gate
Owned typed reader exit is sealed before completion/export analysis; native.json binds that call and completion for later run-gate chains

Saved final-J-weighted retained load is descriptive and is not same-force-stage q*A verification. same_force_stage_qA_guard_verified, same_force_stage_load_budget_verified and force_stage_guard_independently_observed remain explicitly false.
Native safety/schema/clock acceptance does not establish independent half-step accuracy, ON/OFF bit identity, coupled conservation, long-window physical acceptance or GPU dynamic-HG support
No existing solver output, formal XML/BAT, historical reader artifact, metadata field, float field or original threshold is changed

repair.sole_analysis_variable_fix: Rename local $error to $nativeStepError; PowerShell reserved $Error is read-only. Original checks/thresholds unchanged.
repair.adoption: Explicit -AdoptCompletedReader only for exact sealed DebugCPU smoke decoder exit0/completion13exports whose r1 postanalysis failed solely on the readonly variable. Rehash original inputs/outputs/call, then rerun all remaining offline checks. No decoder or solver invocation.
repair.new_record: <jobtag>.native_r2.json; retain failed .native.json and used r1 sources unchanged
repair.future: Without adoption, fresh reader call as before; permit actual owned Run r1 or r2. The actual job tags/output schemas stay r1.
